title: Surgical outcomes after neoadjuvant radiotherapy for lung cancer depending on pneumonitis.
summary: In locally advanced lung cancer, a subset of patients receive radiotherapy before surgery, often in combination with drug therapy. This type of treatment can lead to pneumonitis, which may increase the risk of postoperative complications and mortality. This retrospective study aims to weigh the risks against the benefits of radiotherapy.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of bronchus and lung

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of patients who received an anatomic resection of lung cancer following neoadjuvant radiotherapy between January 01, 2016 and December 31, 2024.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- anatomic resection after neoadjuvant radiotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer
- time period: January 1, 2016 to December 31, 2024
Exclusion criteria:
treatment as part of a prospective study
